sources.title: Training Guide | Piper Documentation
sources.snippet: Training a Model Once you have a config.json, dataset.jsonl, and audio files (.pt) from pre-processing, you can begin the training process with python3 -m piper_train For most cases, you should fine-tune from an existing model. The model must have the sample audio quality and sample rate, but does not necessarily need to be in the same language.
